title: Vimeo connector (Beta)
body:
The Vimeo connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector ingests team, team member, team role, and audit log data from Vimeo into Databricks. Authentication uses a Vimeo personal access token.

See [Vimeo connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/vimeo).
